# Cannibal Perk Card Explained

__Cannibal Perk Card__

**SPECIAL:**

Endurance

**Card Rank and Cost:**

Perk Point Cost: 1

**Allows you to consume the corpses of:**

- Humans (including NPCs and other Players)
- Ghouls
- Mole Miners
- Super Mutants
- Scorched

**Conditions for Perk Card to activate**

**Player (Cannibal)**

- The player is not sitting
- The player is not wearing Power Armor
- The player is not issuing a command (e.g., using a terminal or crafting)

**Target (Victim) PVE**

- Must be dead
- Must not already be eaten
- Must not have the ImmuneToCannibal keyword
- Must be one of the following types:
 - Scorched
 - Super Mutant
 - Feral Ghoul
 - Mole Miner
 - Human
 - Ghoul

**Target (Victim) PVP**

- Must be a player character (not an NPC)
- Must not be on your team*
- Must not already be eaten
- Must be bleeding out (downed, not dead yet)

***Note:** This is currently bugged. During PvP, if a player is on **ANY** team, the option to consume them will be unavailable. - Fixed on the PTS 13th of April 2025

__Cannibal Perk Card__

**Description:**

Increases healing received and hunger restored.

**Cannibal Perk Card Effect:**

- HP Refill: +15 HP over 5 Seconds
- Hunger Refill: +216 over 5 Seconds
- Radiation: +10 Radiation

__Cannibal Perk Card with Carnivore Mutation__

**Description:**

Gain 2× the benefits from meat and meat-based dishes. Receive no benefits from plants or plant-based dishes. Immune to disease and radiation from eating meat-based foods.

**Cannibal Perk Card with Carnivore Mutation Effect:**

- HP Refill: +30 HP over 5 seconds (2× from Carnivore)
- Hunger Refill: +432 over 5 seconds (2× from Carnivore)
- Radiation: +10 Radiation (no change from base)

**Herbivore**

**Description:**

Gain 2× the benefits from plants and plant-based dishes. Receive no benefits from meat or meat-based dishes. Immune to disease and radiation from eating plant-based foods.

**Cannibal Perk Card with Herbivore Mutation Effect:**

- HP Refill: +15 HP over 5 Seconds (no change from base)
- Hunger Refill: +216 over 5 Seconds (no change from base)
- Radiation: +10 Radiation (no change from base)

__Cannibal Perk Card with Bloodsucker Perk Card__

**Description:** Bloodpacks and Cannibal now satisfy thirst, no longer cause radiation, and have a healing bonus increased to 200%.

Bloodsucker Perk Card works with

- Blood Pack
- Cannibal Perk Card
- Glowing Blood Pack
- Irradiated Blood Pack

**Cannibal Perk Card with Bloodsucker Perk Card Effect:**

- HP Refill: +30 HP over 5 seconds (healing ×2 from Bloodsucker)
- Hunger Refill: +216 over 5 seconds (unchanged)
- Thirst Refill: +540 (added by Bloodsucker)
- Radiation: 0 (you no longer take radiation)

__Cannibal Perk Card with Glowing Gut Perk Card__

**Description:**

Irradiated food and drink grant increased radiation.

- Rank 1: Irradiated food and drink grant 100% more radiation
- Rank 2: Irradiated food and drink grant 200% more radiation
- Rank 3: Irradiated food and drink grant 300% more radiation

**Cannibal Perk Card with Glowing Gut Perk Card Effect:**

- HP Refill: +15 HP over 5 seconds (no change from base)
- Hunger Refill: +216 over 5 seconds (no change from base)
- Radiation:
 - Base: +10 Radiation
 - Rank 1 Glowing Gut: +20 Radiation (100% increase)
 - Rank 2 Glowing Gut: +30 Radiation (200% increase)
 - Rank 3 Glowing Gut: +40 Radiation (300% increase)

__Cannibal Perk Card Synergy__

**Cannibal Perk Card with Carnivore, Bloodsucker, Ghoul, and Glowing Gut Effects:**

- HP Refill: +60 HP over 5 seconds (2× from Carnivore, 2× from Bloodsucker)
- Hunger Refill: +432 over 5 seconds (2× from Carnivore)
- Thirst Refill: +540 (added by Bloodsucker)
- Radiation: 0 (eating radiation is blocked by Bloodsucker, so Glowing Gut has no effect)

**Cannibal Perk Card with Carnivore, Ghoul, and Glowing Gut Effects:**

- HP Refill: +30 HP over 5 seconds (2× from Carnivore)
- Hunger Refill: +432 over 5 seconds (2× from Carnivore)
- Thirst Refill: 0 (no Bloodsucker active)
- Radiation:
 - +10 Radiation at Base
 - +20 Radiation at Rank 1 (+100% from Glowing Gut)
 - +30 Radiation at Rank 2 (+200% from Glowing Gut)
 - +40 Radiation at Rank 3 (+300% from Glowing Gut)

**Cannibal Perk Card with Carnivore and Bloodsucker Perk Card Effects:**

- HP Refill: +60 HP over 5 seconds (2× from Carnivore, 2× from Bloodsucker)
- Hunger Refill: +432 over 5 seconds (2× from Carnivore)
- Thirst Refill: +540 (added by Bloodsucker)
- Radiation: 0 (radiation is stopped by Bloodsucker)
